Class ControllerLessonsList

java.lang.Object
guiLessonsList.ControllerLessonsList
public class ControllerLessonsList extends Object

Title: ControllerLessonsList Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lessons Learned list page controller. It reacts to the search box, the Search, Show All, New Lesson, Open, Back, and Quit buttons, the category filter, and the "only my lessons" box. The decisions about which lessons to show and what to say about them are made by ModelLessonsList; this class reads the controls, asks the Model, and puts the answer on screen.

As in the supplied controllers, this is not a class that gets instantiated. It is a collection of protected static methods called by the View, which is why each is protected and none is public.

  • Method Details

    • reloadLessons

      protected static void reloadLessons()

      Method: reloadLessons()

      Description: Reads every stored lesson into the Model (CS-2, CS-12). Reading from the database, rather than keeping whatever was in memory, is what shows lessons recorded in an earlier run of the application.

    • fillCategories

      protected static void fillCategories()

      Method: fillCategories()

      Description: Fills the category filter with "All categories" followed by every category that a stored lesson uses (CS-5). The choice the user had made is kept if that category still exists, so returning from the editor does not reset the filter.

    • applyFilters

      protected static void applyFilters()

      Method: applyFilters()

      Description: Applies the search term, the category, and the "only my lessons" choice together and shows the result with its status line (CS-2, CS-4, CS-5, CS-6). All three controls call this one method, so the list always reflects every choice on screen rather than only the last one changed.

    • showAll

      protected static void showAll()

      Method: showAll()

      Description: Clears the search, the category, and the "only my lessons" box, and shows every lesson (CS-2). This is the way out of an empty search result that the status line points the user to.

    • newLesson

      protected static void newLesson()

      Method: newLesson()

      Description: Opens the lesson editor with an empty form, to record a new lesson (CS-1).

    • openSelectedLesson

      protected static void openSelectedLesson()

      Method: openSelectedLesson()

      Description: Opens the detail page for the lesson on the selected row (CS-3). If no row is selected the user is told so, rather than the button appearing to do nothing.

    • goBackHome

      protected static void goBackHome()

      Method: goBackHome()

      Description: Returns to the home page of the role the user is playing. The role is read from FoundationsMain.activeHomePage, which the home pages set, so this works the same way the supplied account update page returns home.

    • performQuit

      protected static void performQuit()

      Method: performQuit()

      Description: Terminates the application. Every lesson is already stored, so there is nothing to save first.
